# nycdcm

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Provides sf objects from the New York City Digital City Map (DCM) for drawing street maps and working with NYC street data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of nycdcm like so:

``` r
remotes::install_github("kjhealy/nycdcm")
```

## Load

```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(nycdcm)
```

# What's included

## NYC Digital City Map Main Layer

The main DCM layer containing street data for all of New York City.

```{r nyc-dcm}
nyc_dcm_sf
```

```{r nyc-dcm-map, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
nyc_dcm_sf |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(linewidth = 0.1) +
    theme_void()
```

## NYC Digital City Map Arterials and Major Streets

Major streets and arterials layer from the DCM.

```{r nyc-dcmarterial}
nyc_dcmarterial_sf
```

```{r nyc-dcmarterial-map, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
ggplot(nyc_dcmarterial_sf) +
  geom_sf(linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme_void()
```

## Combined View

```{r nyc-dcm-combined, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = nyc_dcm_sf, color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = nyc_dcmarterial_sf, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  theme_void()
```
